name: Prime Rush
storyline: You are a Viajante, an explorer, adventurer, and mercenary. Driven by an insatiable thirst for the unknown, you’ve thrown yourself into strange new lands, worlds scattered across space, time, and beyond, for COVEN, an interstellar syndicate. Using their advanced Portal technology, COVEN has reopened the path to long-lost lands filled with mystery and wonder, all in pursuit of the precious substance known as Cosmium. This program is known as "Prime Rush". And that’s where you come in. One of the floating islands accessible in Prime Rush is MARÉ. After all, Viajantes are known for their hunger for glory and fame, and for their remarkable lack of self-preservation. See you on MARÉ.
summary: Prime Rush is a next-generation mobile battle royale featuring fast matches, high-skill gunplay, and a unique extraction system that lets players choose how they win. Drop into Maré, fight across tight urban environments, collect rare Cosmium, and either survive to the end or extract mid-match for an instant victory.
